body: Quantum physics may be discussed; it may not be used to support a claim about minds. If a claim needs quantum physics to work, it hasn't been shown yet — and when it's ruled out, say plainly why it doesn't apply. (2026-10-03, JayArr: "Context is everything, you have to plainly and clearly refute why it wouldn't be relevant." RULED. Supersedes "quantum mechanics in any explanatory role — removed entirely" in the-cognitive-octave-public.md §5 and recoherence-the-sorter.md §1a.)
plain: Quantum physics may be discussed; it may not be used to support a claim about minds. If a claim needs quantum physics to work, it hasn't been shown yet — and when it's ruled out, say plainly why it doesn't apply.
